prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool (edit mode on Image 1) to make exactly 2 separate images from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. Do not run shell commands or write files. When done, reply with the absolute path of each generated image file, one per line, nothing else.

SPEC:
Repaint the attached exact top-down city plan of Gharn (first image) as a professional AAA RPG world-map illustration in the manner of the Diablo IV and The Witcher 3 maps and the ink maps of Ghost of Tsushima. Keep the layout EXACTLY: every road, plaza, building footprint, yurt, tree, wall line, field and the round central arena stay at the same position, size and shape; north is up; top-down orthographic. Art direction: restrained and elegant, not saturated. A hand-drawn map on aged dark parchment: warm sepia, umber and charcoal ink linework with soft watercolour washes, fine hatching for shadows, subtle paper grain. Crimson is used ONLY as a sparse accent: lacquered roofs of the palace and important halls, a few lantern glows. Houses are drawn as small clean roof shapes with hatched shadow on one side, yurts as small pale circles, roads as light parchment strips with faint stone texture and thin ink edges, the arena as a crisp circular amphitheatre with tier lines, the palisade as a thin dark ink line with small corner towers, sakura trees as tiny soft pink dabs. Outside the walls the steppe fades into darker ink mist and paper toward the edges (strong vignette), with sparse yurt camps barely visible, so the city is the clear focus. Generous negative space, clear hierarchy, readable at small size. NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO icons, NO compass, NO border frame, NO legend.
Input images: Image 1: edit target — change only what is asked, keep everything else identical.
Aspect: square 1:1.
